headline: Gemini 接入 Google Wallet，AI agent 能直接读你的消费数据
bullets: Gemini 新功能：连接 Google Wallet，可生成消费图表、揪出偷偷涨价的订阅、按去年实际花销做节日预算，先在美国上线。
Aside Browser 被 builder 称为所有 AI agent 的「大解锁」，agent 直接操作浏览器的路子越来越被看好。
rauchg 演示用两个 prompt 做出纯 Web Components 应用，agent 直接复用 14 个 UI SDK 行为，不用框架。
Fable 5.2 配套的 prompt-audit 提示词火了：一条命令审计你的 Claude Code 配置和 skill。
builder 们反复在说：现在 AI 的 UX 还太差，模型便宜到用不完，但交互方式远远没跟上。
sentiment: 整体偏兴奋，主要对 agent 能直接操作浏览器、软件和真实数据这件事，同时夹杂对 AI 产品 UX 太烂的吐槽。

posts.name: Aaron Levie
posts.text:
AI models are inevitably going to keep getting better and better at all coding, tool and computer use, math, and other coding-related tasks. As a result, agents that can use software to do their work, or generate code from scratch, will improve at a faster rate than all other domains of knowledge work.

On one hand that could mean that only a small subset of work can get automated. But probably what happens is that more and more work just becomes coding-shaped to adapt to what agents are good at.

You can see it in the most recent examples of model releases in the past couple of months, where agents can generate code that becomes animated videos, games, 3D models for products, and so on. We also know that tool use gives agents the ability to work with much of the same software that people already work with. This helps in cyber, life sciences, finance, and a number of other domains.

Our mental model traditionally has been that the models have to be able to know everything about anything to generate value, but in reality they *really* have to know how to use or generate software effectively combined with deep domain expertise to make the right judgment calls inside of workflows. 

When you have that powerful combination, almost everything else gets unlocked. This is why the acceleration of agents in knowledge work is only going to increase from here.
posts.summaryZh: Levie 认为 agent 在编程和工具使用上进步最快，结果越来越多工作会被改造成「编程形状」来适配 agent，而不只是小部分工作被自动化。

posts.name: Peter Yang
posts.text:
Two very useful prompts to try with Fable 5.2:

"/doctor prompt-audit": Audits your Claude Code setup (Claude md, skills, commands) and proposes fixes.

"/claude-api prompt-audit [skill name]": Audits one skill in depth.

I wish Claude Code auto-suggested running these every time Anthropic releases a new model.

📌 Watch my full tutorial on how I use Fable and Opus here: https://t.co/slyEbWvvqA
posts.summaryZh: Peter Yang 推荐 Fable 5.2 的两个提示词：一个审计你的 Claude Code 配置，一个深挖单个 skill，他希望 Claude Code 每次出新模型都自动提示跑一遍。

posts.name: Amjad Masad
posts.text:
Technology is inherently recursively self-improving and the degree of autonomy has been going up overtime. AI is an accelerant but it didn’t not start this cycle.

Douglas Engelbart understood this. https://t.co/J3Zp1YNFXC
posts.summaryZh: Amjad 认为技术本身就在递归自我改进，AI 只是加速器，这个循环不是 AI 才开始的，Douglas Engelbart 早就看明白了。

posts.name: Amjad Masad
posts.text: We’ve entered Murphy’s world. Anything that can go wrong will go wrong. With billions of things happening at once, recursively interdependent and accelerating rapidly, what’s once considered a rare failure is now a daily thing.
posts.summaryZh: Amjad 说我们进入了墨菲定律的世界：数十亿件事同时发生、互相依赖又加速，以前的罕见故障现在天天出现。
